cost: reading O(n) child scans plus lowercase bytes; antecedent O(n²) conservative for n candidate ancestor walks, O(n) trimming; O(1) auxiliary besides temporary strings. Public invalid indexes panic.
description: Classify it/this/that as pleonastic, event or anaphoric and select a preceding clause for event reference.
forward: Other forms and missing parents return Anaphoric. For it, enabled weather, time/copula, extraposition and small-clause rules return Pleonastic first. it-event off returns Anaphoric next; event verb/copula/because and bare demonstrative rules follow. antecedent computes disjoint left predicates ranked (depth,-position), but returns root-left preceding-conj slice first, then ranked candidate, then previous sentence's first predicate root; trim edge punctuation and trailing cc.
inverse: For reading r, preimage includes all valid sentence/index/environment triples satisfying the first enabled applicable branch. Event result alone cannot recover its predicate, antecedent or lexical form. For antecedent tuple a, all forests preserving winning candidate and exclusion/rank relations are compatible.
limitations: No exhaustive lexical/ablation coverage or arbitrary invalid public Sent tests; percentage surrogate unsupported.
Partial lexical syntax; no executable percentage surrogate; no corpus or universal proof.
